title: Estrogen modulates reward prediction errors and reinforcement learning
goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Estimate proestrus-versus-diestrus dopamine response differences and estradiol/RPE/reward-history associations.
primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Estimate proestrus-versus-diestrus dopamine response differences and estradiol/RPE/reward-history associations.

Source-paper comparison for No ordered model-performance endpoint in the registered estrous/dopamine contrasts: Dopamine AUC contrasts and RPE/reward-history regression coefficients are biological estimands. AUC here means integrated fluorescence, not classifier ROC-AUC.
success_criteria: No paper win is admitted for the registered descriptive associations.
Preserve the biological estimands, population and exclusions; stronger RPE modulation or lower P values are not success.
A new heldout behavior/dopamine predictor must be separately registered and compared with a task-matched source baseline.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.

versions_and_loader_contract.input_code_bridge: The official README maps multiple Zenodo archives, not just Figure2. Figure3 archive directory contains RawData_Figure3.mat; its loader reads ratTrial, Pstruct/Bstruct, times_resampled and stage labels.
